lines.say: They wanted me to run to the one room I hadn't seen.
A small office. One desk. One red phone.
It rang once. I picked it up.
I am the Registrar, a voice said. I run Level Nine.
We hide nothing. We keep a record of what is seen.
What no one sees, stops existing. That is why we need you.
Your next post is Svalbard. The vault under the ice.
